title: Around Gromov's injectivity lemma and applications to post-injunctive groups
summary: Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture states that for all group universes and finite alphabets, every equivariant and continuous selfmap of the full shift, known as cellular automaton, cannot be a strict embedding. Not all surjective cellular automata are injective. However, if the surjectivity condition is replaced by a certain strengthened property called post-surjectivity then all post-surjective cellular automata must be bijective whenever the universe is a sofic group.
